seating.integrityRule: Do not emit ACCEPT or REWORK from producer descriptions, raw candidate metadata, or superseded hashes. Review only the exact hashes above after actual card/detail proof exists.

Shoes: Require upper/outsole/closure construction to read as separate physical parts, not a hue-swapped shoe icon.
At card scale preserve a distinctive lateral/three-quarter silhouette and grounded contact shadow.
Theme and tier must be carried by construction/material detail as well as palette or glow.
Backgear: Require believable avatar attachment logic, body depth and straps/hardware where the item calls for them.
The rear silhouette must remain identifiable at card scale without relying on text, branding or a flat panel graphic.
Reject near-duplicates whose only meaningful change is palette, decals or background VFX.
Handgear: Require grip/handle/body or head separation and plausible hand attachment/orientation.
Preserve a distinct compact silhouette at card scale with material response on the held object itself.
Tier richness should come from physical construction, hardware, material layering and controlled lighting rather than flat recolor.
Seating: Require readable seat/back/base or leg construction with credible thickness and support; avoid bean-like undifferentiated blobs.
Separate upholstery, frame, wood/metal/plastic and trim through texture/highlight response plus cast/contact shadow.
Higher tiers must visibly add construction/material richness while keeping the chair silhouette readable in Store-card framing.

reviews.name: Heart Chair
reviews.reason: Heart silhouette survives card reduction immediately. Deep upholstered lobes, cushion thickness, piping, wood legs and grounded cast shadow make the chair physically credible; cyan/magenta rim light over a dark violet body communicates Midnight Neon through material and lighting rather than a flat recolor. Tier-2 richness is clear without over-spectacle.

reviews.name: Reading Chair
reviews.reason: The broad rolled reading-chair silhouette remains readable at card scale and gains substantial cushion volume, seams, piping, rounded arms, small book attachment and cast shadow. Cream, blush and mint upholstery produces a tactile Candy Core identity instead of a palette-only icon treatment, with an appropriate Tier-2 step above the simpler seating.

reviews.name: Gamer Chair
reviews.reason: High-back racing-chair construction is clear at card scale with bolsters, headrest, neck pillow, armrests, reclining hardware, pedestal and casters. Dark upholstery, green panels and warm orange/tan trim give the Adventure Club theme a rugged physical treatment; material seams, highlights and cast shadow provide the required dimensional upgrade.
